title: Old Republic Appoints New Chief Operating Officer to Home Protection Business
summary: Old Republic Appoints New Chief Operating Officer to Home Protection Business
body_markdown: Old Republic International Corporation (NYSE: ORI) today announced that Frank Caballero (49) will join its Old Republic Home Protection Company (ORHP) home service contract subsidiary as its Senior Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. This appointment takes effect on November 25, 2019.
